instruction: With the model open in SolveSpace, import seed_ss_gui_18_tabbed_plate.dxf from /home/user/Desktop with File > Import, then continue editing that imported drawing rather than starting from an empty document. Launch SolveSpace from `/usr/bin/solvespace` before importing `seed_ss_gui_18_tabbed_plate.dxf`. Do not use File > Open or launch the DXF as a native SolveSpace file. Use the existing base plate, tab guides, and hole-location marks to create the final 180 x 80 base plate with three rectangular top tabs, each width 20 and height 12, with tab center X coordinates 35, 90, and 145. Add three diameter 8 holes inside the plate at (35,30), (90,30), and (145,30). Add one diameter 5 hole centered in each top tab, at (35,86), (90,86), and (145,86). Construction or guide geometry from the seed may be changed or removed unless it is explicitly required above. When the geometry is complete, align the view to the active workplane if needed, then use File > Export 2d View, choose the DXF file type, and save the result as /home/user/Desktop/final_ss_gui_18.dxf. Do not use File > Save As for this final DXF export.
